issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Client.assembleBookstore(): The problem statement and the template's commented signature require assembleBookstore() to return a Bookstore instance. In the solution implementation (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift) the method is declared with return type String on its signature line but returns a Bookstore value (return Bookstore(books: books)), which causes a compile-time error and contradicts the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the assembleBookstore function signature in the solution to return Bookstore (for example: private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore). The function body already constructs and returns a Bookstore, so updating the declared return type will resolve the compile error and align the implementation with the problem specification and template.
